title: GloVe original release
summary: The Stanford NLP Group records August 2014 as the original release of GloVe, prepared by Jeffrey Pennington. The project describes GloVe as an unsupervised learning algorithm for obtaining vector representations for words from aggregated global word-word co-occurrence statistics.
significance: A documented word-representation milestone centered on global corpus co-occurrence statistics and distributed vector representations.

verification.note: The first-party Stanford GloVe project page explicitly records GloVe v1.0 as the original release in August 2014 and describes the algorithm as learning word-vector representations from aggregated global word-word co-occurrence statistics. The ACL Anthology independently corroborates the 2014 GloVe paper and authorship. This record uses month precision only and does not infer an exact release day, institutional geography, ancestry, influence, causality, or relationships.
